provider: N/A (throughput lever, not a host): speakleash/Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0-DFlash, Apache-2.0 DFlash block-diffusion draft for Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0-Instruct (SpeakLeash + ACK Cyfronet AGH, trained on Helios, card dated ~2026-06-24, 301 downloads / 4 likes at check time)
region_dc: N/A. Model weights are on Hugging Face; no hosting region. Host requirement: any EU DC able to run llama-server with a CPU/GPU backend.
sovereignty_class: N/A for hosting. Model is Polish/EU-origin (SpeakLeash, Cyfronet), Apache-2.0, so it adds no CLOUD Act exposure by itself; self-hosting keeps data on the chosen EU host.
monthly_cost: EUR 0 license/model cost (Apache-2.0). Only incremental cost is extra RAM/VRAM for the draft and compute for drafting; it can change the required host tier, not add a fee.
setup_fee_and_lockin: No fee or lock-in. Setup work: convert the draft HF to GGUF with convert_hf_to_gguf.py --target-model-dir <Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0-Instruct HF dir>, optionally quantize to Q4_K_M. [uncertain] no pre-made Bielik DFlash GGUF was found in search; conversion may need to be done by us.
gen_tps_7b_q4: No published Bielik-specific DFlash t/s number found (model card has no benchmarks) [uncertain]. Proxy data from llama.cpp PR #22105 (draft-dflash, CUDA, dense targets, bf16): Qwen3-8B 1.09-1.85x with thinking, 1.49-8.08x without (8x only on highly predictable code, 93% accept); Qwen3-4B 1.12-1.53x with thinking; Qwen3.6-27B Q4_K_M on DGX Spark SpeedBench avg 2.69x (12.57 -> 33.76 t/s; coding 3.11x, rag 4.07x, humanities 2.25x, multilingual 2.56x). DFlash2 PR #27342 on Apple M5 Pro: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M 1.81-1.85x. Reasonable planning range for Bielik 7B Q4_K_M: ~1.5-2.5x on chat/agentic text, up to ~3-4x on structured/JSON/RAG-copy outputs, ~1.0-1.3x worst case [uncertain, extrapolated]. Applied to M4 mini reference TG=24 t/s that would be roughly 35-60 t/s [uncertain]. Caveat: speedup is largest on memory-bandwidth-bound hosts with spare compute (GPU, Apple Silicon); on weak CPUs the verify pass of a 16-token block may cost nearly as much as it saves.
prefill_tps: No effect on prompt processing: DFlash only accelerates decode. Prefill is slightly slower: the draft must also ingest target hidden states for the prompt (Qwen3.8 DFlash2 test on RTX 3090 showed avg prompt t/s 266 vs 289 with MTP, ~8% lower; different model so [uncertain]). For a 4-8k tool-schema prompt, expect prefill_tps to stay equal to or a few percent below plain Bielik Q4_K_M (M4 mini reference PP512=221 t/s).
ttft_at_4k: Roughly unchanged vs baseline, plus a small draft-side prefill overhead (single-digit percent) [uncertain]. DFlash does not reduce TTFT; the M4 mini reference gives ~4096/221 = ~18.5 s baseline, so DFlash would not fix agentic TTFT. Use prompt caching (--cache-reuse / slot cache) for that instead.
concurrency_slots: Weak point: gains degrade with parallel slots. Reports on PR #27342: Intel B70 near baseline at -np 2 and ~1 t/s at -np 4 with DFlash2 (MTP degraded less); another test suggests best at -np 1. Recommend -np 1 (or 2 max) with DFlash for a single agentic stream; do not combine with high -np. Draft has its own KV cache, so memory per slot grows by draft layers x ctx [uncertain, size unknown].
ctx_ram_headroom: Need target Q4_K_M (~4.5 GB) + draft model + draft KV + target KV. Draft size not found in card [uncertain]; DFlash drafts are several transformer layers on a Qwen3 backbone, typically ~0.5-2 GB at Q4_K_M/bf16 for a 7B target (z-lab drafts; Qwen3.8 27B DFlash2 Q4_K_M draft ~ +0.9 GB more for Q8_0). Budget +1-3 GB RAM/VRAM [uncertain]. A 16 GB host is comfortable at 16-32k ctx; 8 GB hosts get tight with draft + KV.
availability_status: Draft weights: available now on Hugging Face (safetensors, Transformers, Apache-2.0, not gated beyond a feedback checkbox). Official run recipes: SGLang > 0.5.6 (--speculative-algorithm DFLASH, 16 draft tokens) and vLLM > 0.20.0 (method dflash, 15 spec tokens). llama.cpp: draft-dflash support is merged in master (docs/speculative.md: --spec-type draft-dflash, -md draft.gguf, --spec-draft-n-max <= block size, -fa on, --jinja; PR #22105 closed/merged, DFlash2 PR #27342 closed). Not mentioned on the Bielik model card; no Bielik-specific llama.cpp validation found [uncertain].
egress_traffic: N/A (host dependent). One-time download of draft weights from Hugging Face.
electricity_metering: N/A for the model. Extra draft compute raises average power draw modestly during decode (host dependent), but shorter generation time per token offsets it [uncertain].
hosting_model: Self-host only: llama-server with -m target.gguf -md draft.gguf --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max 15 -fa on --jinja (use -np 1). Requires a recent llama.cpp master build (mid-2026+). Owner keeps control of chat template and tool-call parser (--jinja). Managed APIs (OVH/Scaleway) do not expose draft models. Alternative server paths: vLLM >0.20.0 or SGLang >0.5.6 (GPU only, FP/bf16 weights, no Q4_K_M GGUF flow).
tool_calling_support: Expected compatible [uncertain, inferred]: speculative decoding is verification-based, so final tokens equal target output; tool-call parsing happens on the generated text, unaffected. Evidence: a PR #27342 tester reported on a V100 that text generation and tool calling work with draft-dflash on llama-server. Caveats: (1) lossless only with greedy / matching sampler; PR flagged non-bit-exact outputs for IQ1_S quant block-verification; (2) grammar/JSON-schema constrained decoding with spec decode has not been confirmed for DFlash [uncertain]; (3) vision/M-RoPE requests failed with draft-dflash on Qwen3.8 (not relevant to text-only Bielik). Must test Bielik tool-call template end to end.
spec_decode_support: Yes on llama.cpp (merged draft-dflash type) in principle, but unverified for Bielik-Minitron target [uncertain]: (a) no GGUF of the Bielik draft or confirmed conversion; (b) draft is qwen3 arch (conversion supports Qwen3-backbone drafts only) while the target is Bielik-Minitron (Mistral-lineage, pruned from Bielik-11B-v3) and llama.cpp must expose target hidden states from the layers the draft was trained on; (c) vLLM/SGLang are the only officially documented servers. Fallback: ngram-mod/ngram-map-k speculative types need no draft and help on repetitive JSON/tool output.
llm_inference_tos: Apache-2.0, permits LLM inference and commercial use. Host-level ToS is unaffected by the draft.
price_stability: N/A (free). Risk is software maturity: llama.cpp DFlash flags and GGUF format changed between Aug 2026 PRs (GGUFs generated before 2026-08-27 needed reconversion for vision), so pin a llama.cpp commit.
model_lock_in: Low: draft is tied to Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0-Instruct (any other target or fine-tune/requant of weights may lower acceptance; Q4_K_M target vs bf16-trained draft acceptance impact not measured for Bielik [uncertain]). Draft can be dropped at any time without changing outputs.
